svg.title: Spolvero: how a drawing reaches the wall, and the agent
svg.desc: Two rows. Above, in the bottega: a cartoon of the tree pricked along its lines with a needle; a bag of charcoal dust patted over the pricked sheet; and the dotted drawing left on fresh plaster, where a painter has begun to paint along the dots. Below, in Sinopia: a frame named garden on the dotted board; the page the export writes into the project, board.png, board.json and board.md; and an agent in a terminal building from it.
svg.text: the drawing, pricked along its lines
patted with a bag of charcoal dust
dots on fresh plaster, to paint by
› build what is drawn in docs/boards/garden
a frame named garden: a tree, a fence,
the page lands in the project
builds from an inventory, not an order
